Create a safer, more accessible bathroom without giving up your industrial look—this extended grab bar is backed by a limited lifetime warranty in Shaded Beige, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes.

  • Shaded Beige adds style to a safety essential
  • Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Keep floors clear with a wall-mounted installation and a compact 3.58 in projection
  • Match loft-inspired spaces with pipe-style bath accessories from the Pipeline collection
  • Count on lasting performance with a durable powder coat finish for corrosion-free and rust-free use

Why it lasts: Iron pipe construction and a protective powder coat finish are built for daily bathroom use.

Complete the look: Coordinate with matching pipeline pieces and other industrial bathroom hardware from the Pipeline collection.

- Projection: 3.58 in

- Material: Iron Pipe

- Assembly required: No
